title: After an etale neighbourhood with trivial residue extension, a finite algebra splits by idempotents into factors with at most one prime over the point (finite case of Stacks 00UK/00UL)
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal and $R	o S$ a ring map making $S$ a finitely generated $R$-module. For a prime $\mathfrak q$ of a ring $A$ write $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ for its residue field, the residue field of the local ring $A_{\mathfrak q}$ (the residue field of $\operatorname{Spec}A$ at the point $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-residue-field]). Then there exist: a ring map $R	o R'$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}R'	o\operatorname{Spec}R$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]; a prime $\mathfrak p'\subset R'$ whose preimage in $R$ is $\mathfrak p$ and such that the induced map $\kappa(\mathfrak p)	o\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ is bijective; an integer $n\ge0$; elements $e_1,\dots,e_n,e_\infty$ of the ring $C=R'\otimes_RS$ (an $R'$-algebra via $r'\mapsto r'\otimes1$) that are complete orthogonal idempotents ($e_i^2=e_i$, $e_ie_j=0$ for $i
eq j$, $e_1+\dots+e_n+e_\infty=1$); and primes $Q_1,\dots,Q_n$ of $C$, each with preimage $\mathfrak p'$ in $R'$, such that (a) $e_i
otin Q_i$ for $i=1,\dots,n$, and (b) every prime $Q$ of $C$ with preimage $\mathfrak p'$ in $R'$ contains $e_\infty$, and for each $i$ with $e_i
otin Q$ one has $Q=Q_i$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00UK (lemma-etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite), in the case $S$ finite over $R$, where every prime over $\mathfrak p$ is a point at which $R\to S$ is quasi-finite, so the factor $B$ there has no prime over $\mathfrak p'$; Mathlib states it as @[stacks 00UL]
